description.zh: 工单附件Key，补充当前工单信息。可通过调用接口[GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The key of the attachment that provides more instructions for the ticket. You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~) operation to obtain the attachment key from the value of the AttachmentKey parameter.

description.zh: 数据导入的业务背景，以减少沟通成本。
description.en: The purpose or objective of the data import. This parameter is used to help reduce unnecessary communication.

description.zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。
description.en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the user who actually invokes the API.

The stakeholders of the data import. All stakeholders can view the ticket details and assist in the approval process. Irrelevant users other than DMS administrators and database administrators (DBAs) are not allowed to view the ticket details.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

descriptions.zh:
仅管控模式为安全协同的数据库实例可调用此API。

关于该功能的更多说明，请参见[数据导入](~~161439~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can invoke this API only for database instances whose control mode is Security Collaboration.

For more information about this feature, see [Data Import](~~161439~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-data-import-order --comment test --related-user-list 510000 --param '{"Classify":"test","CsvFirstRowIsColumnDef":true,"RollbackAttachmentName":"rollback.sql","RollbackSQL":"empty","TableName":"Table_text","ImportMode":"FAST_MODE","AttachmentName":"upload_big_file_test_orders","DbItemList":[{"DbId":18600000,"Logic":false}],"FileType":"CSV","RollbackSqlType":"TEXT","IgnoreError":false,"FileEncoding":"AUTO","ExecMode":"COMMITOR","InsertType":"INSERT"}' --attachment-key order_attachment.txt --tid 3000 --real-login-user-uid 214004479568670000 --region cn-hangzhou
